metadata.status: synthetic example, not a certified occupational taxonomy or personal assessment
metadata.scope: A team designing and implementing asynchronous backend services
metadata.caveat: Local 1-3 scale is illustrative; it is NOT SFIA 1-7 or evidence of actual proficiency. Competency-to-Knowledge links mean learning support, not logically necessary or sufficient mastery.

roles.name: Software Architect (asynchronous backend)
roles.purpose: Choose service boundaries, interface contracts and reliability trade-offs for an asynchronous backend system.

roles.name: Backend Engineer (asynchronous services)
roles.purpose: Implement and verify service behavior and integration contracts in an asynchronous backend.

competencies.name: Specify and validate asynchronous service interfaces
competencies.action: Specify request, result and failure semantics for an asynchronous interface.
competencies.observableOutput: Interface contract and contract test cases
competencies.assessment: Given a service scenario, produce a reviewable interface contract including failure and cancellation behavior.

competencies.name: Explain concurrency and select execution mechanisms
competencies.action: Compare concurrent execution mechanisms and their constraints.
competencies.observableOutput: Execution model rationale with failure cases
competencies.assessment: Explain how scheduling, cancellation and lifetime affect a concrete concurrent workload.

competencies.name: Assess reliability constraints and operational trade-offs
competencies.action: Evaluate operational limits and design mitigation choices for service overload and outages.
competencies.assessment: Given an SLO and overload scenario, identify observable failure modes and justify one mitigation.

competencies.name: Evaluate architecture alternatives against constraints
competencies.action: Compare interface and component design alternatives against stated constraints.
competencies.observableOutput: Architecture decision with consequences and rejected alternatives
competencies.assessment: For a specific change, document options and trade-offs with validation criteria.

competencies.name: Implement and test asynchronous service components
competencies.action: Implement bounded asynchronous work with explicit resource and failure handling.
competencies.observableOutput: Running component with tests for backpressure and cancellation
competencies.assessment: Implement a small async worker with tests covering error and resource cleanup paths.
